question: How far does the purifying power of bathing there on great Māghī extend?
premises: Bathing on great Māghī has purifying power.
This purification can extend to one's lineage.
inference: Bathing there on great Māghī purifies the family up to the seventh generation.
plain_english: Having bathed there on the great Māghī day, one purifies the family up to the seventh generation.
